note: Test-retest studies of the benchmark, written by benchmark/retest.py. 'study' is the latest study recorded from run directories, with one record per site per run so every figure can be recomputed; 'legacy' keeps the two runs of 2026-09-09, measured with a 1.1.x build before the 1.1.2 variance fixes, which have per-site totals only.

legacy.tool: a 1.1.x build, before the 1.1.2 variance fixes
legacy.detail: per-site totals only: no raw reports, so no tier flips or unobservable rates
legacy.note: Two independent full runs of the same benchmark with the same code, so a reader can see how much of a single run's number is measurement and how much is noise. Run 1 was what benchmark/results.json published at the time; run 2 was taken on the same day.

control.note: Same code, same site, three consecutive runs — the spread is inherent, not a consequence of any code change.
